verdict.rationale: For a robotics framework, the sandbox equivalent is simulation and replay. ROS 2 documents launching a simulation with Gazebo (a separate simulator) and its own `ros2 bag` record/play tooling, which can also store synthetic data. A long-time user also says ROS gives you sim and data bagging 'for free' if you follow its conventions. However, the simulator is an external project, and nothing in the evidence documents isolating a test graph from a live or production robot. missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox or isolation mechanism separating test runs from production systems, depth of the simulation workflow beyond a tutorial title, and hands-on corroboration of safe testing workflows.
